content.title: ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ Trailer: Joseph Zada & Whitney Peak Make Their Franchise Debuts
content.text: Skip to main content ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping’ Trailer: Joseph Zada & Whitney Peak Make Their Franchise Debuts We have the first official trailer from Lionsgate for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. Directed by Francis Lawrence, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping revisits the world of Panem and follows young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell. Related Stories Lawrence directed from a screenplay by Billy Ray. The film was produced by Nina Jacobson, Brad Simpson, and Francis Lawrence. Watch on Deadline CC OFFQuality 1080pV324082750360p 720p HD1080p HDAuto OFFEnglish OFFEnglish 360p 720p HD1080p HDAuto V324082750 1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE The ensemble cast also includes Jesse Plemons, Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, McKenna Grace, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, and Kelvin Harrison Jr. The film is set for release on November 20. The Hunger Games franchise encompasses five novels that have sold more than 100 million copies worldwide and been translated into 52 languages, as well as the blockbuster film franchise that has grossed more than $3.4 billion at the global box office, spanning five movies. Sunrise on the Reaping sold over 1.5 million copies worldwide in its first week, marking the biggest debut for any title in Collins’ Hunger Games book series. In the U.S. alone, the book sold 1.2 million copies, more than twice the opening sales of The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes and over three times that of Mockingjay. Check out the trailer above.
